course_name_original: LABORATORIO DI INGEGNERIA INFORMATICA Canale unico

learning_outcomes.text: The course aims to provide the main methodological and technological tools for the design and implementation of complex, secure, and Web-based software systems.
The student must be able to design, develop, and test web-based applications using the Agile methodology and working in a group.

Based on the acquired skills, the student must be able to evaluate the advantages and disadvantages of technologies for developing web-based applications, critically and optimally assess and choose critical security features, and evaluate the development complexity of an application. Furthermore, they must be able to independently update themselves based on possible future technologies.

The student must be able to justify technological, methodological, and architectural choices to other professionals in the sector, as well as present the functioning and characteristics of possible new applications to non-expert individuals.

To stimulate learning ability, practical exercises will be carried out on the various topics covered, and students will be asked to critically use available information for specific problems on various discussion platforms.

The student will acquire and consolidate notions in the design and development of a teacher-assisted project in which they can apply the skills acquired during the courses of their three-year degree program.

assessment_rules: The evaluation will take place through the submission of a project, which will then be discussed with the lecturer.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica e Automatica (L-8)
